## Error Reference

All error types thrown by the library across all languages.

### MzstdError

Why a call failed.

Bindings surface the `Display` text as the
exception message; the underlying `mzstd` error stays reachable through
`std.error.Error.source`.

| Variant | Message | Description |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| `InvalidLevel` |  | The compression level is outside `MIN_LEVEL..=MAX_LEVEL`. |
| `Compression` | compression failed: {0} | The encoder failed. |
| `Decompression` | decompression failed: {0} | The input is not valid Zstandard data or breaks a decoding limit. |
| `Dictionary` | invalid dictionary: {0} | A trained dictionary is malformed. |
| `InputTooLarge` | input of {input_size} bytes is too large to compress | The compression bound of the input does not fit in `usize`. |
| `StreamClosed` | the stream is finished or failed; create a new one | A stream was used after `finish` or after an earlier call failed. |
